entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have this helmet I bought. I'm looking at it now and... I just don't think it's right. The website was all a bit much for me. I'm so confused. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A fault? I... I don't think so. The box is still unopened, so I wouldn't know. My daughter said the color wasn't right for visibility on the road. And now I'm worried. You know, safety is the most important thing.
I completely understand, and you are absolutely right, safety is our top priority. It sounds like the main concern is the color preference. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment.
Okay. I just... I hope this can be sorted out. I feel a bit helpless about it.
Not a problem at all. I see here you purchased the Urban Commuter Helmet 72 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh! Really? So I can send it back? I thought I had missed the chance. That's a huge relief.

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and it's within the timeframe, we can definitely process that return for you. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just attach that to the original box and you can drop it off.
Wow, okay. That's so much simpler than I thought. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've really helped me.
You are very welcome. We'll issue a full refund as soon as we receive the helmet. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
